task: Build a complete compiler-derived inventory of SDK and production package exports.
observation: The production package scanner already discovered all 26 roots, but one pre-existing source mismatch prevented compiler interface emission for packages/time: pad_digit returned Char from char_at while declaring String. The Moss Char.to_string() conversion made the intended boundary explicit, and the package suite passed in Debug and Release.
impact: A source package failure had been indistinguishable from an empty generic export set in downstream coverage accounting. Fixing it allows the refreshed compiler-derived inventory to classify that package rather than carrying an unexplained missing root.

resolution.summary: Converted the in-range digit Char to String with Char.to_string(); all 11 package tests pass in Debug and Release. Refreshed all 26 package roots with zero failures and four compiler-emitted open generic exports. Inventory metadata now records the exact compiler executable and binary SHA-256.

tool_used: moss-dev diagnostic, Margo package tests, and compiler-derived package inventory
suggestion: Keep package build failures distinct from empty generic export sets, pin the compiler executable in inventory runs, fingerprint the binary, and resolve output paths before printing the completion report.
